items.t: Automatic transmission shifts hard or fails
items.note: Owners report about $3,500 for a rebuild. A used unit can cost less.

items.t: Throttle module fault causes stalling and limp mode (recall)
items.job: Recall software update at a dealer
items.note: The recall is a software fix. If the throttle module itself must be replaced outside any coverage, you pay for the part and labor.

items.t: ABS module fails and turns on warning lights
items.job: Replace ABS control module with a rebuilt unit
items.note: Owners of the same-platform V70 report about $600. Rebuild services can cost less.

items.t: Clogged PCV system pushes out oil seals
items.job: Replace PCV hoses, oil separator and gaskets
items.note: The intake manifold must come off. A blown rear main seal adds a lot more.

items.t: Immobilizer stops the car from starting
items.job: Replace immobilizer antenna ring or module and recode keys
items.note: Owners report about $400 for an antenna ring and up to about $1,700 when the module is replaced.
One owner paid about C$540 for a driver's door latch.

items.t: Hardtop rattles, wind noise and water leaks
items.job: Adjust or replace roof and windshield seals
items.note: Owners report about C$300 for an adjustment and about C$1,100 for a new windshield-top seal.

items.t: Clogged PCV oil trap causes leaks and codes
items.job: Replace PCV oil trap and hoses
items.note: Same engine family as the S40/V50 T5; owners report about $90 to $700.

items.job: Test battery and charging system; replace battery if weak
items.note: Also ask a dealer whether the 2006-2007 software updates were done.

items.job: Replace A/C compressor (or clutch) and recharge
items.note: One C70 owner paid about $1,000; a clutch-only repair can be a few hundred dollars.
